title: danthonia hieronymi
intro: Danthonia hieronymi, commonly known as Hieronym's oatgrass, is a type of flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to soothe and calm the body and mind. The health benefits of Hieronym's oatgrass include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
